verdict.rationale: A state tax portal could plausibly offer a natural-language assistant or chat-driven way to file, pay, or check status, so the axis applies. The evidence pack shows no such capability: the portal is a conventional authenticated web interface (de-dor-probe-4), and agent-facing surfaces such as llms.txt and OpenAPI all return 404. Human Live Support during business hours is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.
